topic: Is the Science Museum in London open on Sundays, and when does it open?

text: Is the Science Museum in London open on Sundays, and when does it open?

note: 07:30-15:30 Jonas at the hospital, phone in the locker

text: Sorry, shift. No idea honestly. I thought most london museums are open every day but not sure about times
Right. I'd rather have the actual answer before we pick a Sunday 🙂
@claude Is the Science Museum in South Kensington, London, open on Sundays, and what time does it open? Please check the official website and give me the Sunday hours.

Yes, the Science Museum looks to be open on Sundays, from 10:00 to 18:00. Last entry is at 17:15, and the galleries start closing about 30 minutes before the museum does.

I couldn't open the official Science Museum website, because my connection to it was refused. This comes from third-party listings, mainly Art Fund, so please check sciencemuseum.org.uk before you commit to a date. Free entry needs a pre-booked ticket. The museum is closed on 24, 25 and 26 December. A couple of sites said it's closed on Mondays and Tuesdays outside school holidays, which doesn't affect a Sunday.

Sources: Art Fund (artfund.org/explore/museums-and-galleries/science-museum), plus whichmuseum.co.uk and wonderfulmuseums.com for the other details.
